caption: Forum of Pompeii, Pompeii
composition: Floodlit Roman forum ruins with Vesuvius beyond at night · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The camera looks down the forum's stone paving from between the ruins. A long colonnade of floodlit columns runs up the left side, while the raised podium temple with its row of illuminated columns stands on the right. Beyond the scattered foundations the dark cone of Vesuvius closes the horizon, and the 05:03 scenario is true night with warm artificial light on the stone against a black sky.
alt_text: AI-generated artistic interpretation of the Forum of Pompeii floodlit at night with Mount Vesuvius in the distance
